title: Lightweight rod, heavy finial
text: Lightweight rod, heavy finial. The finials are suprisingly heavy for this curtain rod. I like that they weren't hollow. But the rod itself is reeeeeally light weight. The above pix is the rod extended to 47". I ended up putting a piece of electric electrician's tape in the middle so it wouldn't pop out. It hung that way without the curtain on it. Very easy to hang. Took me about 10 minutes. I used included screws, but used a metal drywall anchor.
